After a gap of nearly 20 years since I last played the drums, I felt the urge to reconnect with music—this time through strings. When I met Mr. Lakshmikant with the intention of learning guitar, he suggested I try the mandolin instead. His conviction and expertise instantly won me over, and I began my mandolin journey under his guidance.

Mr. Lakshmikant is not only a professional mandolin artist but also a master of all string instruments. What truly sets him apart is his humility, depth of knowledge, and a unique teaching style that makes learning both enjoyable and effective.

In just two months, I’ve seen a remarkable improvement in my skills. His attention to detail, focus on fundamentals, and personal attention have made all the difference. He teaches students ranging from 12 to 90 years old with the same enthusiasm and dedication, which speaks volumes about his patience and passion for teaching.

I wholeheartedly recommend Mr. Lakshmikant Sharma to anyone looking to learn the mandolin, guitar, or any string instrument. Whether you're a complete beginner or someone rediscovering music like me, you're in the best hands with him.

featured_reviews.name: Richa Bharadwaj
featured_reviews.review_text: My daughter has had a wonderful experience at this playschool. The teachers are warm, patient, and truly care about each child’s development. The environment is safe, nurturing, and full of fun learning activities. I have seen great improvements in her confidence, communication, and social skills. Its like a home away from home. The teachers and staff have gone above and beyond their expected responsibilties to care for my child when I couldn't be there. Highly recommend this place for little ones!

featured_reviews.name: varsha sidhpura
featured_reviews.review_text: 1 of the best day care. They take care of minute things. Have personally seen growth for my twin daughters. 100% hygiene and provides homemade food. Including all extra activities for the week ( Dance, yoga, art, craft, gymnastics and more Excellent staff. Very polite and always smiling... All Didi's who take care of kids are well educated and cheerful.. Would 100% recommend if one thinks of enrolling for Daycare.

featured_reviews.name: Rachana Chawda
featured_reviews.review_text:
My Happy Place is truly a haven for little ones—a safe, comfortable, nurturing environment where my 2-year-old daughter feels at home.

“It’s the next best place after a mother’s arms".The team here puts in incredible effort to support each child’s growth, focusing on everything from 'fine motor skills' to 'essential life skills'. They introduce 'yoga', organize 'enriching field trips', and make learning fun and full of care. Each activity is handled with such dedication and love, making this daycare a true second home for my child.
My daughter has a learnt how to have a clear pronunciation of so many words , she can count from 1-20. She can recite 4-5 poems and sing the National Anthem too. I couldn’t ask for a better place for her well-being and development!"

featured_reviews.name: Devanshi Gorakh
featured_reviews.review_text: Probably one of the best preschools and daycare in town! Every kid is individually taken care of and it truly makes a difference in shaping them and their future!! The teachers are outstanding and the staff is helpful and caring!! The warmth and the environment of the place truly makes it a happy place!! I highly recommend it!!🥰💖

featured_reviews.name: Wahbiz Khan
featured_reviews.review_text: Happy Place is a blessing for working parents. My daughter was only 6 months when we joined and she is turning 1 now. The care, helpfulness and support provided is highly recommendable. Positive and comfortable environment for kids. Very satisfying to see my child happy.

featured_reviews.name: Avani Dave
featured_reviews.review_text: Best and safe place for my child. Entire team is excellent. Thank you My Happy place family.

featured_reviews.name: Yashaswini Vishal Suvarna
featured_reviews.review_text: This place is just as its name says a happy place for kids. Staff are so kind, responsible and caring. They look after infants with atmost love, care and are always on their toes. This place changed our perception about day care. I so wish I found this place way back in 2017🥰🥰.  Would also like to mention we opted for this place through one of this kind of google review when I suddenly decided to restart my career after a break of 7 long years and  it just turned out to be my son's favorite place to be🥰 and a blessing to we parents.

featured_reviews.name: taher khilawala
featured_reviews.review_text: Our child is very happy and com comfortable at My happy place. It is a very homely feeling with very good food and snacks served to children. The activities such as dance, yoga, craft, phonics, gymnastics, games, are up to the mark. Teachers are very loving and good care taking didis at daycare. Ronak sir is the best. It is the best day care experience for our kid.

featured_reviews.name: Arunima Ghosh
featured_reviews.review_text:
This Music Academy is one of the best music schools I know. I am learning music from Shagota Guruji, and she explains every word of a song with proper notation and the best techniques.

We learn music here with passion and love. She creates a friendly and positive environment in every class. Since we are beginners, she first makes us feel confident and comfortable in the classroom. Her guidance in every song is always a wonderful experience.

Her daughter, Sagarika Chakrabarty, is also a very talented teacher of classical and light music.

In one line, I feel I have chosen the best music class for myself, with such God-gifted teachers. ♥️

featured_reviews.name: Sapna Janjani
featured_reviews.review_text: Shagota Music Academy is one of the best Academy to learn music. It is expert in teaching to all the ages from kids to senior citizens. I am learning from both Gurus there, they put their 100% to teach their students. I have developed love for singing.

featured_reviews.name: Dipali Damani
featured_reviews.review_text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

With Shagota ma’am, learning’s a treat,
Her patience and care can’t be beat.
She guides every way,
Brings joy to the day,
And makes every class feel complete.

Her teaching is steady and kind,
She nurtures both talent and mind.
With warmth and with cheer,
She draws students near,
A mentor so rare to find.
Highly recommended.

featured_reviews.name: Hina Meswani
featured_reviews.review_text:
Learning with Shagota ma’am is like attending a class where music meets magic. She notices every little detail, gives her heart to each student, and somehow manages to reply faster than most of us can think.

Her warmth extends not just to the learners but to their families too, making everyone feel at home. The energy in her classes is so infectious that students look forward to them like a favourite festival.

Shagota ma’am is not just a teacher, but also a mentor, motivator, and a gentle force of inspiration. Happy to have started my singing journey with Shagota Music Academy. Highly recommended.

featured_reviews.name: Rittika at Ariyona Interior
featured_reviews.review_text:
After a 20-year break from singing, I was nervous to start again, but Sagota Ma’am’s gentle and encouraging approach put me at ease right away.

What truly stands out is how Sagota Ma’am pays attention to the finer nuances of music — those subtle aspects that are often overlooked but make a world of difference in a student’s progress.

And despite all the learning, every class with her is a whole lot of fun! It’s a rare combination of gaining deep knowledge while genuinely enjoying each session.

I’m so grateful to be learning with her!

featured_reviews.name: Esha Mehta
featured_reviews.review_text: SMA is not just any music class for me . It is a place where I feel at peace and connect with the divine through music. Sagota maam is truely amazing and so is Shagreika di . Great music mentors and teachers who patiently help each one of their students in their musical journey. Glad to be a part of the SMA family ❤️

featured_reviews.name: Dipti Nadarr
featured_reviews.review_text:
It is an amazing musical experience and Journey for me and my daughter. We both joied SMA as an amateur not knowing anything about music.

But the trained and immensely knowledgeable teachers like - Shagota ma'am, Rani maa, Shagerika, Summi & Kaanak ma'am made it all so easy to understand each and every aspect of music.

The teachings- Hindustani classical with a dash of Bollywood is fun way to learn and grow. The songs, Raags, rthym everything is taught with utmost ease and comfort. You will fall in love with music one more time.

Its been a journey of 4 years and many more to come. ❤❤❤❤

featured_reviews.name: Madhuri Motiwala
featured_reviews.review_text: My music journey from SMA uder SHAGOTA MA'AM since 2 years is amazing. My music interest and my voice quality has improved very much. SHAGOTA MA'AM and SAGARICA MAAM both are very encouraging and devotional. I m very much thankful for their way to teaching me and encourageing my musical journey

name: Buzz & Blow Music Academy
description: At the Buzz & Blow Music Academy, we offer the artists & students a golden opportunity to learn the western music language (Western/Staff Notations) music at a minimal cost. Western Notation Certificate holds incredible importance for many government jobs in India & abroad. We customize the curriculum as per our students' needs. Our program consists of many Woodwind & Brass instruments such as Western Flute, Clarinet, Saxophone, Recorder, Trumpet, Trombone & Euphonium. There are absolutely no age criteria to learn music. Our students' ages vary from 7-64 years of age. No matter where you live in India & abroad, or what your time constraints are, we will have a solution!
